_comment: Synced to the live local stack 2026-11-19. The backend is the HyperQwen vLLM 27B fleet arm on :8080 (uap-hyperqwen-server, one rail, 131072 pool, MTP k=3) — see config/model-profiles/qwen38.json for the authoritative record. The proxy path is unchanged; the vLLM arm ENFORCES the served model id on the direct route (404 otherwise), so the direct entry below carries the profile's model field verbatim — update both together on every arm swap.

qwen3.8-27b.name: Qwen3.8 27B (direct)
qwen3.8-27b._model_id_comment: The id the live :8080 backend SERVES. The strata-era continuity argument for the old qwen38-gsq-rco-27b key (strata ignores requested model ids) died with the 2026-11-19 arm swap: the HyperQwen vLLM arm 404s any id except its served alias (fleet log 2026-11-19 18:39:37), so this key is the profile's model field verbatim — update both together on every arm swap.

_limits_comment: Proxy path: context 114688 is the PER-SESSION cap the qwen38 profile applies via the x-uap-model-profile header — deliberately below the live pool (131072 on the HyperQwen vLLM arm since the 2026-11-19 swap) so a session at the cap leaves the engine working room; admission 4 (operator decision 2026-11-18) degrades contention to queueing, not pool corruption. Direct path bypasses the proxy and the profile, so it sees the whole 131072 pool and carries no guardrails; use it for probing, not for agent work — and it must carry the served alias (qwen3.8-27b), which the vLLM arm enforces with a 404. output 32768 matches the proxy's tool-turn cap (PROXY_TOOL_TURN_MAX_TOKENS), which is what nearly every agentic turn hits.
_reasoning_comment: reasoning: true — the server runs --reasoning-format auto and the proxy streams thinking deltas (PROXY_STREAM_THINKING_DELTAS=on). The old 'false' hid that output.
_token_comment: apiKey is {env:UAP_PROXY_TOKEN}, NOT a literal: this file is tracked in git and the live proxy token must never land in history. Export UAP_PROXY_TOKEN in your shell; the value lives in the untracked ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json, which scripts/sync-local-agent-configs.sh reads (it never prints the secret).
_auth_posture_comment: Requests currently succeed WITHOUT a token, and the reason is not the one it looks like: PROXY_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_BIND=1 is a startup BIND-time assertion only (anthropic_proxy.py ~15355) and never runs per request. The request gate is `if PROXY_AUTH_TOKEN and ...` (~5519), and PROXY_AUTH_TOKEN is simply unset. There is NO loopback exemption in that gate: if an operator ever sets PROXY_AUTH_TOKEN, an unset {env:UAP_PROXY_TOKEN} will 401 even from 127.0.0.1. Note also that :4000 and :8080 are both bound to 0.0.0.0 and were verified on 2026-09-20 to answer unauthenticated from the LAN address — so this is an open inference endpoint on the local network, not a loopback-only service.
